scripts.build: haxe build.hxml && sass --pkg-importer=node --no-source-map src/rad.scss web/rad.css && esbuild web/rad.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/bundle.js
scripts.release: haxe build.hxml && sass --pkg-importer=node --no-source-map src/rad.scss web/rad.css --style=compressed && esbuild web/rad.js --minify --allow-overwrite --outfile=web/rad.js && esbuild web/rad.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=web/bundle.js
scripts.dev: haxe build.hxml && (sass --pkg-importer=node --no-source-map src/rad.scss web/rad.css --watch & esbuild web/rad.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/bundle.js --watch=forever --servedir=web & watchexec -e hx,hxml -w src -w build.hxml haxe build.hxml)
scripts.deploy: npm run release && . ./.env && rsync -avz web/ "${DEPLOY_TARGET:?set DEPLOY_TARGET in .env}"
